import networkx as nx

given_edges = [
    (5,13), (8,15), (1,4), (0,4), (8,10), (0,15), (3,10), (7,12), (10,15), (3,7), (4,5), (2,9), (0,9), (3,15), (0,10), (6,9), (3,5), (3,4), (1,14), (6,8), (10,11), (3,14), (4,6), (7,9)
]

# Add cycle edges to ensure 2-connectivity
cycle_edges = [(i, (i+1)%16) for i in range(16)]

all_edges = set(given_edges)
for e in cycle_edges:
    u, v = e
    if u > v:
        u, v = v, u
    all_edges.add((u, v))

G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(16))
G.add_edges_from(all_edges)

print("Number of edges:", G.number_of_edges())
print("Is connected:", nx.is_connected(G))
print("Vertex connectivity:", nx.node_connectivity(G))

# List all edges sorted
sorted_edges = sorted(list(all_edges))
print("Edges:", sorted_edges)
